scenarios: HIGH: prepareInputs derives Hardener attack surfaces from trackedModuleSources(context) read from the live checkout, while candidateDiff and changedPaths are calculated from candidate.baseRevision to candidate.headRevision. The Candidate remains valid when HEAD advances as a descendant, so an unrelated post-freeze edit can change dependency imports in the live checkout and thereby add or remove derived surfaces. The Hardener then receives surfaces for content different from the frozen Candidate while all manifest Candidate fields still identify the old digest. Surface derivation must materialize/read exactly candidate.headRevision or reject any checkout drift.

LIMITATION: prior input-scope, opaque-launcher, stale-lock, transition, external-envelope, and malformed-trace findings were re-tested and are not retained as blockers/high findings under the clarified contracts and fresh diff.
LIMITATION: no deterministic commands or unauthorized policy files were inspected; this report is based solely on the authorized fresh diff and manifests.
